spec.rawSql:
WITH viable AS (
    SELECT
        repository.pushed_at AS pushed_ts,
        toUnixTimestamp(head_commit.timestamp) AS commit_ts,
        repository.full_name AS repo
    FROM push
    WHERE repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND ref = 'refs/heads/viable/strict'
      AND head_commit.id != ''
),
main AS (
    SELECT
        repository.pushed_at AS pushed_ts,
        toUnixTimestamp(head_commit.timestamp) AS commit_ts,
        repository.full_name AS repo
    FROM push
    WHERE repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND ref = 'refs/heads/main'
      AND head_commit.id != ''
)
SELECT fromUnixTimestamp(pushed_ts) AS pushed_time, lag_minutes, trend_7d_avg
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.pushed_ts,
        (toInt64(m.commit_ts) - toInt64(nullIf(v.commit_ts, 0))) / 60.0 AS lag_minutes,
        avg(lag_minutes) OVER (
            ORDER BY m.pushed_ts
            RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS trend_7d_avg
    FROM main m
    ASOF LEFT JOIN viable v
        ON m.repo = v.repo AND m.pushed_ts >= v.pushed_ts
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(pushed_time)
ORDER BY pushed_time ASC

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    revert_day,
    prs_reverted,
    sum(prs_reverted) OVER (
        ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(revert_day) ASC
        RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 24 * 60 * 60 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) / 7.0 AS trend_7d_avg
FROM (
    SELECT
        toStartOfDay(head_commit.timestamp) AS revert_day,
        COUNT() AS prs_reverted
    FROM push
    WHERE
        repository.full_name = '$repository'
        AND ref IN ('refs/heads/master', 'refs/heads/main')
        AND (
            head_commit.message LIKE 'Revert %'
            OR head_commit.message LIKE 'Back out%'
        )
        AND $__timeFilter(head_commit.timestamp)
    GROUP BY revert_day
)
ORDER BY revert_day DESC

WITH commits AS (
      SELECT
          commit.id AS commit_sha,
          commit.timestamp AS commit_time
      FROM default.push
      ARRAY JOIN commits AS commit
      WHERE
          repository.full_name = '$repository'
          AND ref = 'refs/heads/main'
  ),
  blocking_runs AS (
      SELECT id
      FROM default.workflow_run
      WHERE
          head_branch = 'main'
          AND event = 'push'
          AND path IN (
              -- Core
              '.github/workflows/lint.yml',
              '.github/workflows/pull.yml',
              '.github/workflows/trunk.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor-periodic.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor-unittest.yml',
              '.github/workflows/periodic.yml',
              '.github/workflows/slow.yml',
              '.github/workflows/dynamo-unittest.yml',
              -- Modern hardware
              '.github/workflows/rocm-mi300.yml',
              '.github/workflows/rocm-mi355.yml',
              '.github/workflows/xpu.yml',
              '.github/workflows/mac-mps.yml',
              '.github/workflows/tsan.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor-rocm-mi300.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor-rocm-mi355.yml',
              -- Distributed
              '.github/workflows/b200-distributed.yml',
              '.github/workflows/h100-distributed.yml',
              -- Adjacent / integrations
              '.github/workflows/dtensor.yml',
              '.github/workflows/inductor-pallas.yml',
              '.github/workflows/vllm.yml',
              '.github/workflows/torchtitan.yml'
          )
  )
  
SELECT
    commits.commit_time AS commit_time,
    round((countIf(default.workflow_job.conclusion = 'failure') / count()) * 100.0, 2) AS failure_percent,
    avg(failure_percent) OVER (ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(commits.commit_time) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 24 * 60 * 60 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS trend_7d_avg
FROM default.workflow_job
INNER JOIN commits ON commits.commit_sha = default.workflow_job.head_sha
INNER JOIN blocking_runs ON blocking_runs.id = default.workflow_job.run_id
WHERE
    default.workflow_job.run_attempt = 1
    AND $__timeFilter(commits.commit_time)
GROUP BY commits.commit_sha, commits.commit_time
ORDER BY commit_time ASC

WITH
  commits AS (
    SELECT
      toStartOfDay(head_commit.timestamp) AS day,
      head_commit.id AS sha
    FROM push
    WHERE repository.full_name = '$repository'
      AND ref IN ('refs/heads/master', 'refs/heads/main')
      AND $__timeFilter(head_commit.timestamp)
  ),
  all_runs AS (
    SELECT workflow_run.id AS id, commits.day AS day, commits.sha AS sha
    FROM workflow_run FINAL
    JOIN commits ON workflow_run.head_sha = commits.sha
    WHERE lower(workflow_run.name) IN ('lint', 'pull', 'trunk', 'linux-aarch64')
      AND workflow_run.event != 'workflow_run'
      AND workflow_run.id IN (
        SELECT id FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_head_sha
        WHERE head_sha IN (SELECT sha FROM commits)
      )
  ),
  all_jobs AS (
    SELECT all_runs.day AS day, all_runs.sha AS sha, workflow_job.conclusion AS conclusion,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workflow_job.name, workflow_job.head_sha
                         ORDER BY workflow_job.run_attempt DESC) AS row_num
    FROM workflow_job FINAL
    JOIN all_runs ON all_runs.id = workflow_job.run_id
    WHERE workflow_job.name NOT IN ('ciflow_should_run', 'generate-test-matrix')
      AND workflow_job.name NOT LIKE '%rerun_disabled_tests%'
      AND workflow_job.name NOT LIKE '%mem_leak_check%'
      AND workflow_job.name NOT LIKE '%unstable%'
      AND workflow_job.id IN (
        SELECT id FROM materialized_views.workflow_job_by_head_sha
        WHERE head_sha IN (SELECT sha FROM commits)
      )
  ),
  per_commit AS (
    SELECT day, sha,
      max(row_num = 1 AND conclusion IN ('failure', 'timed_out', 'cancelled')) AS broken_trunk_red
    FROM all_jobs
    GROUP BY day, sha
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 AND countIf(conclusion = '') = 0
  ),
  daily AS (
    SELECT day,
      countIf(broken_trunk_red) AS red_count,
      COUNT(*) AS commit_count
    FROM per_commit
    GROUP BY day
  )
SELECT
  day AS time,
  red_count * 100.0 / commit_count AS red_percent,
  sum(red_count) OVER w * 100.0 / sum(commit_count) OVER w AS trend_7d_avg
FROM daily
WINDOW w AS (
  ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(day) ASC
  RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY day ASC

spec.description: Share of main commits classified as red on the trunk-blocking workflows (Lint, pull, trunk, linux-aarch64). A commit is red if any job's latest run_attempt is failure/timed_out/cancelled. Commits with pending jobs or fewer than 10 jobs are excluded. Mirrors the test-infra HUD '% commits red on main (broken trunk)' definition.
spec.title: % Commits Red on Main (broken trunk) [repository]

spec.rawSql:
WITH per_name AS (
    SELECT
        toStartOfDay(workflow.created_at) AS day,
        lower(workflow.name) AS name,
        quantileExact(0.5)(DATE_DIFF('second', workflow.created_at, workflow.updated_at)) AS p50_sec
    FROM default.workflow_run workflow FINAL
    WHERE
        workflow.conclusion = 'success'
        AND workflow.run_attempt = 1
        AND lower(workflow.name) IN ('pull', 'trunk', 'docs-build')
        AND workflow.repository.full_name = '$repository'
        AND $__timeFilter(workflow.created_at)
        AND workflow.id IN (
            SELECT id FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_created_at
            WHERE created_at >= $__fromTime AND created_at <= $__toTime
        )
    GROUP BY day, name
),
daily AS (
    SELECT day, max(p50_sec) AS pull_trunk_docs_tts
    FROM per_name
    GROUP BY day
)
SELECT
    day AS time,
    pull_trunk_docs_tts,
    avg(pull_trunk_docs_tts) OVER (
        ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(day) ASC
        RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trend_7d_avg
FROM daily
ORDER BY day ASC

spec.description: Daily p50 TTS = max of the per-workflow p50s (pull, trunk, docs-build) over successful attempt-1 runs — HUD's 'p50 pull, trunk, docs-build TTS' bucketed by day. Blue = 7d avg. Thresholds: amber = target 3h, red = 4.5h. Repo-scoped, so reads higher than HUD's headline (which pools executorch + tokenizers).
spec.title: p50 pull, trunk, docs-build TTS [repository]

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    day AS time,
    pull_tts,
    avg(pull_tts) OVER (
        ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(day) ASC
        RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trend_7d_avg
FROM (
    SELECT
        toStartOfDay(workflow.created_at) AS day,
        quantileExact(0.5)(DATE_DIFF('second', workflow.created_at, workflow.updated_at)) AS pull_tts
    FROM default.workflow_run workflow FINAL
    WHERE
        workflow.conclusion = 'success'
        AND workflow.run_attempt = 1
        AND lower(workflow.name) = 'pull'
        AND workflow.repository.full_name = '$repository'
        AND $__timeFilter(workflow.created_at)
        AND workflow.id IN (
            SELECT id FROM materialized_views.workflow_run_by_created_at
            WHERE created_at >= $__fromTime AND created_at <= $__toTime
        )
    GROUP BY day
)
ORDER BY day ASC

spec.rawSql:
WITH
latest_prs AS (
    SELECT
        number AS pr_number,
        -- Deduplicate the complete PR snapshot before filtering its current state.
        -- pull_request is a ReplacingMergeTree with no version column; this matches FINAL.
        argMax(tuple(state, labels, closed_at, user.login), updated_at) AS latest
    FROM default.pull_request
    WHERE
        -- Trailing slash so pytorch/pytorch doesn't match pytorch/pytorch-integration-testing
        dynamoKey LIKE '$repository/%'
    GROUP BY number
),
merged_prs AS (
    SELECT
        pr_number,
        parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(latest.3) AS merge_time
    FROM latest_prs
    WHERE
        latest.1 = 'closed'
        AND arrayExists(x -> x.'name' = 'Merged', latest.2)
        AND latest.3 != ''
        -- pytorchupdatebot PRs sit open for weeks and skew the tail
        AND latest.4 != 'pytorchupdatebot'
        AND $__timeFilter(merge_time)
        AND merge_time < toStartOfDay(now())
),
merge_attempts AS (
    SELECT
        toUInt32(extractGroups(issue_url, 'issues/([0-9]+)')[1]) AS pr_number,
        created_at,
        -- One workflow sometimes posts the explainer twice (3.8% of PRs), so count
        -- distinct runs. Present on 100% of these comments over 12mo; fallback if not.
        extractGroups(body, 'actions/runs/([0-9]+)')[1] AS run_id
    FROM default.issue_comment
    WHERE
        dynamoKey LIKE '$repository/%'
        AND user.login = 'pytorchmergebot'
        AND body LIKE '%Merge started%'
        AND created_at <= $__toTime
),
attempts_per_pr AS (
    SELECT
        mp.pr_number AS pr_number,
        toStartOfDay(mp.merge_time) AS merge_day,
        uniqExact(if(ma.run_id = '', toString(ma.created_at), ma.run_id)) AS attempt_count
    FROM merged_prs mp
    CROSS JOIN merge_attempts ma
    WHERE
        ma.pr_number = mp.pr_number
        AND ma.created_at <= mp.merge_time
    GROUP BY mp.pr_number, merge_day
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        merge_day,
        -- Winsorized at 5: merge-polling bots produced 45-84 attempt PRs, and uncapped
        -- one bot's retirement fakes a -14% Mar->Aug drop. 5 is where the artifact vanishes.
        avg(least(attempt_count, 5)) AS merge_attempts_avg,
        sum(least(attempt_count, 5)) AS total_attempts,
        count() AS prs
    FROM attempts_per_pr
    GROUP BY merge_day
)
SELECT
    merge_day AS time,
    merge_attempts_avg,
    -- PR-weighted, not a mean of daily means, so thin weekend days don't dominate
    sum(total_attempts) OVER w / sum(prs) OVER w AS trend_7d_avg
FROM daily
WINDOW w AS (
    ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(merge_day) ASC
    RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY merge_day ASC

spec.description: Mean pytorchmergebot merge attempts per landed PR — distinct workflow runs, winsorized at 5. 1.0 = landed first try; y-axis floor is 1.0, so the shaded area is retries. Blue = 7d PR-weighted avg. HUD's 'Merge retry rate (avg)', bucketed by merge day rather than PR-creation day (HUD's cohort is right-censored, ~10% low on the trailing week). Counts CI-driven retries only; ghstack members attribute to the stack's top PR. Amber 1.56 / red 1.78. Today excluded; empty for executorch.
spec.title: Avg Merge Attempts per Landed PR [repository]

spec.rawSql:
WITH
latest_prs AS (
    SELECT
        number AS pr_number,
        -- Deduplicate the complete PR snapshot before filtering its current state.
        -- pull_request is a ReplacingMergeTree with no version column; this matches FINAL.
        argMax(tuple(state, labels, closed_at, user.login), updated_at) AS latest
    FROM default.pull_request
    WHERE
        -- Trailing slash so pytorch/pytorch doesn't match pytorch/pytorch-integration-testing
        dynamoKey LIKE '$repository/%'
    GROUP BY number
),
merged_prs AS (
    SELECT
        pr_number,
        parseDateTimeBestEffortOrNull(latest.3) AS merge_time
    FROM latest_prs
    WHERE
        latest.1 = 'closed'
        AND arrayExists(x -> x.'name' = 'Merged', latest.2)
        AND latest.3 != ''
        -- pytorchupdatebot PRs sit open for weeks and skew the tail
        AND latest.4 != 'pytorchupdatebot'
        AND $__timeFilter(merge_time)
        AND merge_time < toStartOfDay(now())
),
merge_attempts AS (
    SELECT
        toUInt32(extractGroups(issue_url, 'issues/([0-9]+)')[1]) AS pr_number,
        created_at,
        -- One workflow sometimes posts the explainer twice (3.8% of PRs), so count
        -- distinct runs. Present on 100% of these comments over 12mo; fallback if not.
        extractGroups(body, 'actions/runs/([0-9]+)')[1] AS run_id
    FROM default.issue_comment
    WHERE
        dynamoKey LIKE '$repository/%'
        AND user.login = 'pytorchmergebot'
        AND body LIKE '%Merge started%'
        AND created_at <= $__toTime
),
attempts_per_pr AS (
    SELECT
        mp.pr_number AS pr_number,
        toStartOfDay(mp.merge_time) AS merge_day,
        uniqExact(if(ma.run_id = '', toString(ma.created_at), ma.run_id)) AS attempt_count
    FROM merged_prs mp
    CROSS JOIN merge_attempts ma
    WHERE
        ma.pr_number = mp.pr_number
        AND ma.created_at <= mp.merge_time
    GROUP BY mp.pr_number, merge_day
),
daily AS (
    SELECT
        merge_day,
        -- Prevalence, not severity: each PR counts once however often it was retried,
        -- so bot polling can't move it. Hence no winsorization, unlike panel-10.
        100.0 * countIf(attempt_count >= 2) / count() AS pct_needing_retry,
        countIf(attempt_count >= 2) AS prs_retried,
        count() AS prs
    FROM attempts_per_pr
    GROUP BY merge_day
)
SELECT
    merge_day AS time,
    pct_needing_retry,
    -- PR-weighted, not a mean of daily means, so thin weekend days don't dominate
    100.0 * sum(prs_retried) OVER w / sum(prs) OVER w AS trend_7d_avg
FROM daily
WINDOW w AS (
    ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(merge_day) ASC
    RANGE BETWEEN 6 * 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
)
ORDER BY merge_day ASC

spec.description: Share of landed PRs taking more than one pytorchmergebot merge attempt. Prevalence companion to 'Avg Merge Attempts per Landed PR': that panel measures severity and is tail-sensitive, this one weights every PR equally, so no polling bot can move it. The two capture different behavior: Mar–May→Jun–Aug the mean was flat (1.72→1.70) while this rose 42.5%→45.3%. Blue = 7d PR-weighted avg. Same cohort as panel-10. Amber 35% / red 50%. Today excluded; empty for executorch.
spec.title: % of Landed PRs Needing a Merge Retry [repository]
